description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeDetailedModel class, a model for serializing detailed employee data in the OrangeHRM system's API. It includes annotations for API schema documentation and methods for setting data filters and attributes based on an Employee entity.

classes.name: EmployeeDetailedModel
classes.description: A model class for serializing detailed employee information for API responses, using data from an Employee entity and including various related sub-objects like job title, subunit, employee status, and supervisors.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the model with an Employee entity and configures data filters and attribute mappings.
